summary: Z(γ) is the lattice frame Gram matrix of an integral position.

steps.claim: Z(γ) mapped to 𝔸_f equals the lattice frame Gram matrix of termPosition(c, c', γ) (frameGram_termPosition), which is integral: J_lat is integral (unimodular) and the position is integral (γ is a term). An element of E that is integral at every finite place is an algebraic integer.
steps.lean:
simpa using congr($frameGram_termPosition a b).subst
    (S.isUnimodular_latMiddle.splitGram.isIntMatrix.mul (termsOver.isIntMatrix_termPosition k) _ _)
